cases.case_label: Alu repeat insertion in CAPN3 intron 7 with c.1194-9A>G altering CAPN3 mRNA processing
cases.mechanism_detail: Three patients of one consanguineous family shared the c.1194-9A>G change together with an Alu repeat insertion/rearrangement in intron 7 of CAPN3. RT-PCR of muscle RNA showed a transcript lacking the first seven exons and retaining the last eight nucleotides of intron 9, which the authors attribute to disruption of pre-existing intronic splicing regulatory elements by the Alu insertion.
cases.quote: We report here genetic and transcriptional analyses in three Tunisian patients belonging to the same consanguineous family sharing the same mutation c.1194-9 A>G and Alu repeats insertion in intron 7 of CAPN3 gene.
